cited.quote: Advocates Welfare Fund from Rs.5.25 lakh to Rs.7.00 lakh

rationale: C1 reports that the Government have enhanced the assistance paid from the Advocates Welfare Fund from Rs.5.25 lakh to Rs.7.00 lakh, matching the promised 7 lakh. C2 shows the earlier step to Rs.5.25 lakhs. No GO date is given, so the date used is C1's document date, an upper bound.
